source.title: Operating Dataset of Liquid Hydrogen Refueling Station
source.title_zh: 液氢加氢站运行数据集

mass: start/end mass or an auditable integration rule

expected_files.name: 液氢加氢站运行数据集数据说明 .docx

eligibility_rule.full_loop_case: An untouched fueling event with a common time base, vehicle/receptacle pressure and temperature, transferred mass or mass flow, station-side source/dispenser channels, initial state, protocol/stop semantics, and rights for derived journal metrics.
eligibility_rule.holdout_rule: All eligible fills are scored once with the frozen model; no parameter fitting, time warping, case selection, or threshold changes after numerical outcomes are opened.
eligibility_rule.promotion_rule: Promote only if the source file hashes, channel dictionary, rights statement, case mapping and common time-base audit all pass. Missing vehicle-side or protocol channels remain an explicit ineligibility result.

quarantine_plan: Download the listed original files only after this protocol is committed.
Compute SHA-256 and retain file sizes and source IDs before opening numerical cells.
Read the description and headers for schema/provenance; do not tune the model from outcomes.
Freeze eligible-event mapping and score the locked model once on untouched cases.
Publish only de-identified derived traces, hashes, case metrics, and rights-permitted metadata.
claim_boundary: This protocol is prospective intake control. It is not evidence that the dataset contains a synchronized vehicle-side full-loop trace, and it does not by itself support safety-distance, HRS certification, or SAGA-effectiveness claims.
